description.value: Chaiiwala of London is a British-South Asian franchise cafe known for specialty chai drinks like Karak Chaii and Limbu Pani alongside desi-inspired street food including roti rolls and savoury snacks. The New Westminster location occupies a unit at 607 Belmont Street and offers indoor seating, making it a warming rest stop with a distinctly different flavour profile from standard coffee shops. Cyclists looking for a chai fix or a quick desi bite will find this a novel option on a BC touring route.
